Yes, it ends in four-eight-one.
And is the contact number ending in five-five-two right?
Yes, that is correct.
Is the statement in paper or electronic format?
Electronic, it arrives by email.
Would you like the outcome by email as well?
Yes, email is fine.
And is the heating electric or gas?
It is all electric here.
Hmm and regarding your property, has anyone been out to the property recently?
No, nobody has visited.
Ok. And have you added any large appliances lately, like a hot tub or an electric vehicle charger?
No, nothing new like that.
Would you like a breakdown by period?
Yes, that would be helpful.
Sure, I can arrange that for you. Also, has your household size changed at all this quarter?
No, still the same two of us.
Do you pay by a fixed monthly amount?
Yes, a fixed amount each month.
Okay, do you know if your property is on a smart meter, or if it has a traditional meter?
Something to note: the property has a second meter that arrived with the extension.
I will Send the figure you gave me for automated validation.
Okay, I will wait to hear back.
I checked back after twenty-five minutes and the figure has been marked as incomplete.
I will Record every supply connection on the account before validating again.
